text: FastPay wallet holds USDT, BTC, and SOL. Check balances, receive, and transfer from the Wallet screen. Day-to-day spend prefers USDT liquidity.
title: Wallet

text: Pay and track bills — rent, utilities, subscriptions. Add a bill, pay from wallet, track monthly spend by category.
title: Bill Pay

text: Analytics shows income, spend percent, savings goals, and cash flow. Set savings goals and review weekly burn.
title: Analytics

text: Apply for a personal, business, or salary loan. Eligibility depends on KYC level and repayment history. Prefer savings before borrowing.
title: Loans

text: Complete KYC with national ID and proof of address to raise transfer limits. Status and level are shown in Settings.
title: KYC

text: Buy crypto with mobile money (MoMo). Top up USDT for spending or accumulate BTC/SOL for longer-term growth.
title: Buy

text: Escrow holds funds until goods or services are delivered. Buyer funds, seller delivers, then release or dispute.
title: Escrow

text: Family wallet pools money, sets spending limits, and parent approvals for household members.
title: Family Wallet

text: Reset your 4-digit transaction passcode after verifying your login password. Passcode never leaves the device.
title: Passcode

text: Offline receive lets you accept payments over Bluetooth when the network is unavailable.
title: Offline Pay

text: Convert between USDT, BTC, and SOL inside FastPay. Rates update when Connected.
title: Convert

text: Irembo government services — national ID, birth certificate, police clearance, land title, driving license fees.
title: Irembo
